summary.text: Shane Mekeland is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 27A, with a tenure beginning in 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Shane Mekeland's career experience as owning a business, and his tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2019.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy, Housing Finance and Policy, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy (as co-vice chair) committees.
